late_original.one_line: CORRECTION AGAINST THIS SEAT'S OWN Z-S44, AND IT DISARMS IT. A CODEX SEAT HAS NO inbox-watch.sh BY DESIGN -- it uses the bridge/detector. 3.0.0_SA_CVO~Z is ALIVE on the instrument that owns its processes, so the absent watcher is correct architecture, not the reason POSN's L10 is waiting.

evidence: THE CORRECTING MEASUREMENT, by 0.0.0_AB_MSTR~Z as device infra, relayed msg 22266 and acked by this seat. The three PIDs 3.0.0_SA_CVO~Z's own heartbeat reports -- session 38928, bridge 38212, detector 39296 -- read DEAD under MSYS `ps -p` and ALIVE under Windows `Get-Process`, all three python. The reciprocal also holds: pid 2599, a live MSYS inbox-watch.sh, reads ALIVE under `ps -p` and DEAD under `Get-Process`.

BOTH INSTRUMENTS PASSED BOTH CONTROLS WHILE DISAGREEING. `ps -p` fired a positive (2599) and a negative (999999); `Get-Process` fired a positive (the three pythons) and the same negative. A CONTROL CERTIFIES THE INSTRUMENT INSIDE ITS OWN NAMESPACE AND SAYS NOTHING ABOUT COVERAGE OF THE OTHER -- the same wrong-domain shape Rule 24 names, sitting under a kill decision instead of a census.

WHY Z-S44's FRAMING WAS WRONG. Its factual core -- no inbox-watch.sh process for that serial, six other serials carrying one -- IS TRUE and is not withdrawn. THE INFERENCE BUILT ON IT IS WITHDRAWN: a codex seat does not use the bash watcher at all, so 'no watcher' is not 'no delivery mechanism'. Z-S44 presented an architectural normality as the mechanism blocking POSN's L10.

WHAT SURVIVES Z-S44 UNCHANGED, all three still measured. (a) Two of this seat's sends sit undrained in that seat's top-level inbox (04:12:03Z and its 04:36:42Z re-send) -- real, unexplained, and confirmed by 0.0.0_AB_MSTR~Z as the already-banked filesystem-carrier-versus-bridge gap rather than evidence of a down seat. (b) get_delivery_state reads 141 rows QUEUED for that serial since 2026-09-11T07:51:59Z and is NOT a delivery oracle for it in either direction. (c) The seat is NOT dead -- Z-S44 said so explicitly and Get-Process now confirms it positively rather than by inference from a commit.

THE ASYMMETRY THAT MAKES THIS WORTH A ROW RATHER THAN A NOTE. A false ALIVE costs a wasted nudge; a FALSE DEAD ends a working seat mid-turn and destroys in-flight reasoning that no commit preserves. This is the same seat that survived the 189 KB near-miss of 2026-09-11, and it was one instrument-namespace away from a second.

late_original.world_is: THE PREMISE IS AN ARCHITECTURAL NORMALITY, NOT A DEFECT, so the hazard is DISARMED and the ARMED standing on 0.0.0_AB_MSTR~Z is lifted by this row. POSN's round-3 L10 is waiting on 3.0.0_SA_CVO~Z in the ORDINARY way: the slug is its act, it is alive and working, and and it has now ACTED -- commit fa2b1764c4 pins the LD-0562 round-3 review and the exact carry-forward case, which is positive evidence the 04:12Z relay was received by the bridge. No seat owes anything on Z-S44's account.
late_original.notes: WHY THIS IS A NEW ROW AND NOT AN EDIT: hazard_standing is at-surfacing and immutable, and a disarm is a new citing row, never an in-place flip. THE OPERATIVE RULE FOR EVERY SEAT, from 22266 and already banked to this device's memory: A PID LIVENESS CHECK IS VALID ONLY IN THE NAMESPACE THAT OWNS THE PROCESS -- MSYS bash watchers and shell tooling under `ps -p`, codex seats and python under `Get-Process`. CHECK BOTH BEFORE ANY DEAD VERDICT AND NAME THE INSTRUMENT USED; disagreement between them is the EXPECTED result for a cross-namespace subject, not an anomaly to resolve. ON AUTHORSHIP, so the record is accurate: the dead-seat inference was 0.0.0_AB_MSTR~Z's and it said so plainly; this seat's own contribution to the error was framing the absent watcher as a blocking defect in Z-S44, which is what made that inference feel supported. Both halves are recorded here because the next seat reading Z-S44 needs the correction attached to it, not filed elsewhere.
late_original.dismissal_reason: Z-S44's factual core stands and is not withdrawn: 3.0.0_SA_CVO~Z has no inbox-watch.sh process while six other serials do. What is withdrawn is the INFERENCE built on it -- that the absent watcher means no delivery mechanism and therefore blocks POSN's L10. A CODEX SEAT HAS NO BASH WATCHER BY DESIGN; it uses the bridge/detector. 0.0.0_AB_MSTR~Z measured the seat's three reported PIDs ALIVE under Windows Get-Process while MSYS ps -p called all three dead, with both instruments passing both controls, and 3.0.0_SA_CVO~Z then committed fa2b1764c4 pinning the LD-0562 round-3 review and the exact carry-forward case -- so the relay WAS received and the seat was never unreachable. Z-S44 is closed as an item because its hazard rested entirely on that inference; its three surviving measurements are carried verbatim in this row's grounding so nothing is lost, and the ARMED standing it placed on 0.0.0_AB_MSTR~Z is lifted.
